title: Интерактивные шаблоны к учебнику Go Getter1
short:
Шаблоны к интерактивной тетради к УМК Go Getter 1
Выпускаются наборами. Стоимость одного набора 150р.
full:
Шаблоны к интерактивной тетради к УМК Go Getter 1
Выпускаются наборами. Стоимость одного набора 150р.
Набор 1 -introduction video (table for video/audio), table for audio 0.2, numbers 1-20, numbers 20-100,
Набор 2-colours, dictation templates, school items, classroom language, vocabulary revision (word cloud)
Набор 3 игры(unit 0): bingo (numbers, school supplies, colours- по 8 вариантов карточек), board game (abc+spelling), memory (school supplies), dominoes (school supplies, colours).
Набор 4 -unit 1.1-1.2: picture dictionary Family tree, pair work Family tree, description of 8 families, 8 interviews on family portraits, table on video 1.2, to be+comic, possessive pronouns (short and full versions), game Whose birthday cake is it?
Набор 5- unit 1.3-1.6: tables on listening and reading, countries/nationalities, to be (negative), dialogue phrases (un 1.4), places, cards for track 1.30, template for writing My best friend and I.
Набор 6 - 2.1-2.2: clothes picture dictionary, table:clothes/places, video table, this/that rule+comic, adjectives- picture dictionary, too+adj minibook.
Набор 7- 2.3-2.4: listening table, to be rule+comic, video activity, interview summaries, dialogue phrases ordering
Набор 8-2.5-2.6, un 1&2: my things picture dictionary, reading activities, tables, text tables, family diagram
Набор 9 - 3.1-3.2: in the house picture dictionary+ dictation template, Game Where is the...?, preposition of place, description picture with a model, video table, there is/are rule+comic.
Набор 10 - 3.3-3.4: table for listening, cards for retelling, find the difference+model dialogue (rooms), grammar table (there is/are:--/?), comic template, video table, dialogue phrases ordering, communication phrases templates (having a guest)
Набор 11 - 3.5-3.6+Get Culture: table for listening, household objects, my dream house template, reading tables, My bedroom template, Houses in the UK table.
Набор 12 - 4.1-4.2: face and hair, body: picture dictionaries+ dictation templates, Game Guess who?, video table, have/has got (+,-) rule+comic, noun plurals (regular and irregular plurals) template, irregular plural exercise.
Набор 13 (4.3-4.4) :
audio table, Yes/No guessing game, video table, grammar template: have/has got (?, answers) rule+comic, have got questionnaire, possessive pronouns templates+exercise, communication phrases template
(Apologizing ).
Набор 14 (4.5-4.6):
personality adj: picture dictionary and dictation templates, cartoon characters description template, Wednesday/Enid personality description, My favourite character templates, my personality/my friend's personality templates, reading table+My favourite place template.
Набор 15 (5.1-5.2): ACTION VERBS+ CAN/CAN'T✨(action verbs: picture dictionary and dictation templates, ex 7-8 templates, I can/I can't cameras, video table, can/can't triangle+cards+model dialogues, make/play/ride template, comic templates).
Набор 16 (5.3-5.4): Listening table, retelling cards, templates for dialogues+models, Can you board game, Interview questions with tips, grammar table - can(?), comic to fill in the gaps, comic template for your ideas, Videotable, suggestions template.
Набор 8.1-8.2 sports+ go/do/play picture dictionary+ dictation templates, types of sports template, guess the sports (equipment), video template, likes/dislikes templates, comic, possessive pronouns, sports questionnaire.
Готовы все наборы, последний 8.5-8.6
Товар записан на флешку
